about.subline: Focused on distributed architectures, Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers, event-driven pipelines, and developer tooling.
paragraphs: I'm Kiran — a backend and AI engineer based in Bangalore, India (open to relocate and remote). I engineer the systems that sit quietly underneath products, handling scale, concurrency, and reliability.

Having built AI-powered health platforms serving 5M+ users at Ultrahuman, multi-tenant B2B architectures at Pencil, and developer tooling at KeyValue, I focus on the seam of scale, performance, and craft.

My work centers on Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers, autonomous agent workflows, event-driven microservices, high-throughput database schemas, and developer SDKs. I'm actively seeking full-time and remote backend / AI engineering opportunities.

gallery.caption: Ultrahuman Ring AIR — Offline-first health & sleep computation engine built with Kotlin Multiplatform
Blood Vision & Performance Lab — AI-powered biomarker reporting platform serving 5M+ users
Behavioral Recommendation Engine — Automated LLM localization and growth workflows driving 8k+ conversions

experience.summary: AI-powered health reporting and growth platforms serving 5M+ users.
experience.headline: Architecting offline-first biomarker intelligence and AI health reporting for 5M+ global users.

chapters.title: The Product & Scale
chapters.body: Ultrahuman builds metabolic and longevity hardware—including the Ring AIR and Blood Vision—trusted by over five million users worldwide. As the user base scaled rapidly across regions, the platform needed sub-second vital computations that worked reliably even without network connectivity, alongside AI-interpreted biomarker reports that felt personal and clinically grounded.

chapters.title: Offline-First Kotlin Multiplatform Engine
chapters.body: We migrated core sleep, recovery, and vital-sign computation pipelines from cloud-dependent services into a shared Kotlin Multiplatform (KMP) engine running natively on device. This cut vital computation latency by 80% and unlocked 100% offline execution, so users wake up to instant sleep and recovery scores anywhere in the world.

chapters.title: AI Health Reporting & Growth Systems
chapters.body: For Blood Vision and multilingual health insights, we built resilient LLM orchestration workflows paired with automated validation, quality assurance, and fallback recovery—reducing AI localization failures by 67%. Alongside the reporting stack, we shipped a behavioral recommendation engine that turned real-time biometric signals into contextual nudges, generating over 8,000 conversions within its first sixty days.

bullets: Engineered AI-powered backend systems serving 5M+ users with LLM workflows, experimentation frameworks, and automated quality control.
Reduced vital computation latency by 80% and enabled 100% offline execution by migrating health and sleep computations to Kotlin Multiplatform.
Reduced AI localization failures by ~67% with automated validation, quality assurance, and recovery workflows.
Built a behavioral recommendation engine that generated 8k+ conversions within two months.

gallery.caption: Pencil — B2B AI ads SaaS platform with metadata-driven multi-tenant architecture and server-side rendering

experience.summary: B2B generative AI ads platform: event-driven microservices, metadata-driven multi-tenant schemas, and server-side PDF rendering.
experience.headline: Overhauling microservices into event-driven architecture and metadata-driven multi-tenant schemas.

chapters.title: Platform Overhaul & Event-Driven Architecture
chapters.body: Pencil is a B2B generative AI platform used by global brands to create, predict, and scale high-performing ad creatives. During a ground-up platform overhaul, we refactored core microservices into an event-driven architecture with a custom ORM and message queues to decouple ingestion from heavy asset rendering.

chapters.title: Metadata-Driven Multi-Tenant Schemas
chapters.body: Built an extensible metadata-driven multi-tenant database layer that allows enterprises to define custom typed fields, types, and lookup values dynamically on the fly, eliminating brittle hardcoded database migrations.

chapters.title: Headless Server-Side Vector Rendering (+65% Speed)
chapters.body: Migrated document and creative rendering from browser processes to sandboxed server-side worker fleets, cutting asset export times by 35% and boosting high-resolution PDF generation speed by 65%.

bullets: Refactored distributed microservices and implemented event-driven processing, improving scalability and reducing infrastructure costs.
Built metadata-driven multi-tenant schema that supported configurable fields, types, and lookup values for enterprise tenants.
Migrated document rendering to server-side infrastructure, reducing export load times by 30–40% and improving PDF generation speed by 65%.

experience.metricSummary: -80% Dev Time · < 1ms Latency · MCP Server · NPM & PyPI Distributed

gallery.caption: Siren — Communication rails, JS/Python SDKs, and MCP server for autonomous AI agent workflows

experience.summary: Communication rails, official TypeScript & Python SDKs, and Model Context Protocol (MCP) server for autonomous AI agents.
experience.headline: Engineering universal communication rails, published client SDKs, and MCP servers for autonomous AI agents.

chapters.title: Universal Communication Backbone for Agentic AI
chapters.body: Siren provides unified notification and communication infrastructure for engineering teams and autonomous AI agents. As AI products shift from single prompts to multi-agent teams, inter-agent messaging and tool protocol compliance become the primary architectural bottleneck.

chapters.title: Model Context Protocol (MCP) Server & Connectors
chapters.body: Architected a high-performance Model Context Protocol (MCP) server enabling Claude desktop and external server agents to seamlessly interface with tools and data resources. Standardized integration connectors for OpenAI Function Calling and CrewAI agent swarms, cutting developer integration time by ~80%.

chapters.title: Official SDKs Published to NPM & PyPI
chapters.body: Engineered idiomatic TypeScript/JavaScript and Python async client SDKs with zero-overhead message serialization (< 1ms). Shipped automated GitHub Actions CI/CD matrix testing and published official packages to NPM and PyPI, reaching 160+ peak downloads.

bullets: Accelerated AI agent orchestration by building core communication modules enabling efficient multi-agent workflows.
Reduced AI feature development time by ~80% by building JavaScript and Python SDKs, an MCP server, and integrations for OpenAI and CrewAI.
Published SDKs to NPM and PyPI (160+ peak downloads), improving developer adoption and release reliability.

gallery.caption: Glome — Full-stack mental health & wellness platform built with Flutter and Django
Anonymous Therapist Messaging — Secure real-time counseling and appointment scheduling on AWS

experience.summary: Full-stack mental health platform using Django, Flutter, MongoDB, and AWS.
experience.headline: Designing a privacy-first digital sanctuary connecting patients with licensed mental health professionals.

chapters.title: The Vision — Accessible Mental Healthcare
chapters.body: Glome was conceived to lower the barrier to mental health support by giving users a safe, stigma-free mobile space to share experiences, book therapy sessions, and communicate with licensed counselors without exposing their identity.

chapters.title: What Was Built — Flutter, Django & AWS
chapters.body: We delivered the end-to-end mobile and backend experience using Flutter for a calm, responsive cross-platform interface and Django + MongoDB on AWS for the backend. Key modules included encrypted anonymous therapist messaging, real-time calendar availability and appointment booking, and community content feeds.

bullets: Built content sharing, anonymous therapist messaging, appointment scheduling, and scalable AWS services.

gallery.caption: airPMO — Construction SaaS platform connecting field teams, equipment, and subcontractors
Real-Time Site Sync — Cross-platform Flutter modules synchronizing 10+ active construction sites

experience.summary: Construction SaaS platform connecting people, material, equipment, and subcontractors.
experience.headline: Unifying field engineers, heavy equipment, and subcontractor workflows across active construction sites.

chapters.title: The Challenge — Field-to-Office Coordination
chapters.body: Large-scale infrastructure and construction projects suffer from fragmented communication between on-site engineers, material suppliers, and project management offices. airPMO set out to replace paper logs and scattered spreadsheets with a unified mobile command center.

chapters.title: What Was Built — Cross-Site Flutter Sync
chapters.body: We built cross-platform Flutter modules tailored for field conditions—enabling real-time progress tracking, equipment allocation, and subcontractor sign-offs that synchronized seamlessly across more than ten concurrent construction projects.

bullets: Built Flutter features that improved collaboration and synchronization across 10+ active projects.

projects.title: Valkyrie
projects.description: An artisan wallpaper companion for macOS. Point to any folder and glide through artwork with fluid gestures, spatial depth, and zero system overhead.
projects.headline: A tactile, zero-overhead macOS companion that turns local artwork folders into a living spatial gallery.

gallery.caption: Valkyrie — Spatial 3D wallpaper gallery for macOS with hardware-accelerated fluid gestures
Zero-Overhead Native Engine — Instant folder indexing and live desktop transitions

chapters.title: Why Valkyrie Exists
chapters.body: Default wallpaper pickers treat curated photography and digital art like static file lists. Valkyrie was designed for collectors and designers who want to point to any local folder on their Mac and glide through high-resolution artwork with physical inertia and spatial depth.

chapters.title: Native Craft & Zero Daemon Overhead
chapters.body: Built natively for Apple Silicon with hardware-accelerated Metal rendering, Valkyrie indexes thousands of 5K wallpapers instantaneously without background CPU drain, applying smooth cross-fade transitions directly to the macOS desktop space.

projects.headline: Sub-second time-synced lyrics floating effortlessly over your macOS workspace.

gallery.caption: Lyrix — Floating glassmorphic lyrics HUD for macOS with 120Hz ProMotion synchronization
Passive Media Stream — Zero-recording system audio event listener for Spotify & Apple Music

chapters.title: The Experience
chapters.body: Lyrix brings an unobtrusive, click-through glassmorphic HUD to macOS that displays real-time word-by-word lyrics while you code or design—staying out of your way and adapting automatically to underlying window contrast.

chapters.title: Event-Driven ProMotion Sync
chapters.body: Instead of polling or recording microphone audio, Lyrix hooks into native macOS Now Playing media events and renders syllable transitions at 120Hz ProMotion frame rates with near-zero memory footprint.

chapters.body: Designed a multi-task federated learning architecture where edge clients train task-specific heads locally while aggregating shared representation layers centrally—preserving strict data locality across heterogeneous datasets.

faqs: Do you both design and build websites?
Yes. I handle the whole thing, design and development, with one set of hands. My experience spans full-stack products, backend platforms, and the interfaces that connect people to them.
Where are you based, and do you work remotely?
I'm based in Bangalore, India (open to relocate and remote) and work with teams across the world.
What technologies do you build with?

I work mostly with Ruby on Rails, TypeScript, Node.js, Python, FastAPI, React, PostgreSQL, Docker, AWS, and MCP. I choose the tools around the problem rather than forcing every product into one stack.
Can you build an online store or e-commerce site?
Yes. I've built service architectures and inventory and order-processing workflows for e-commerce products, with a focus on reliable backend systems and integrations.
How much does a website cost?

It depends entirely on what you need. I work across a wide range of budgets, from smaller sites through to large, complex builds. Tell me what you have in mind and I'll scope it and give you a clear, fixed quote.
How long does a project take?
Most sites take from a few weeks to a couple of months, depending on scope, content readiness and how many rounds of feedback we go through. I'll give you a realistic timeline up front.
Can you redesign or rebuild my existing website?

Yes. A lot of my work is refreshing tired sites that no longer reflect the quality of the business, including migrations from older WordPress builds, with care taken to keep your SEO and rankings intact.
Do you offer ongoing support after launch?
Yes. I offer ongoing support and retainer agreements to keep your site updated, secure and performing after launch and as your business scales.
